items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 49:1
items.html: Since these posteriors of AVI come from the discernment of AVI and the NHY of Keter, which are the KHB of Nekudim, corrected with the correction of the lines from the essence of their emanation in the discernment of back to back, which is through the illumination of the upper Ima — therefore, even after they fell from the Rosh to the place of HGT, they are also influenced by the discernment of back to back of AVI that was not nullified, and the correction of their lines continues over the posteriors as well. (p. 555, Item 22)
